principles_applied.name: Visibility of system status
principles_applied.user_problem: Users act blindly when the system hides what it is doing.
principles_applied.application: Every async action exposes LOADING and a terminal SUCCESS/ERROR with a live-region announcement.
principles_applied.tradeoff: More states to design and test.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Status changes are announced via polite live regions.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Status stays visible when layouts collapse (never inside a collapsed drawer only).
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Components expose explicit async state props, not implicit spinners.

principles_applied.name: Fitts's law — target size and distance
principles_applied.user_problem: Small or distant targets cause missed taps and slow pointing.
principles_applied.application: Interactive targets are at least 24x24 CSS px (WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8), 44x44 for primary touch actions.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Primary actions go FULL_WIDTH on narrow touch viewports.

principles_applied.name: Jakob's law — follow platform conventions
principles_applied.user_problem: Novel interaction patterns force users to relearn basics.
principles_applied.application: Use native controls and standard placements; nonstandard interactions must justify themselves.
principles_applied.tradeoff: Less room for novelty in core controls.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Native elements carry correct roles and keyboard behavior by default.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Standard navigation transforms (MENU/DRAWER) instead of bespoke gestures.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Prefer semantic HTML elements over div-based widgets.

principles_applied.name: Truthful progress
principles_applied.user_problem: Fake progress bars and invented ETAs destroy trust.
principles_applied.application: Show determinate progress only when the backend reports it; otherwise indeterminate + elapsed time.
principles_applied.tradeoff: Less reassuring than a fabricated percentage.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Progress uses role=progressbar with aria-valuenow only when determinate.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Progress stays in the primary region when layouts stack.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Progress components accept `determinate: false` without a value.

principles_applied.name: Visual hierarchy through salience budget
principles_applied.user_problem: Users cannot find the primary task among decoration.
principles_applied.application: Salience is budgeted: P0 strongest, P3 never outweighs P0.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Heading levels mirror the visual hierarchy.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: PRIORITY_REDUCTION drops P3 before compressing P0.

principles_applied.name: Immediate, proportionate feedback
principles_applied.user_problem: Actions without feedback get repeated or abandoned.
principles_applied.application: Every press shows PRESSED within one frame and a result within the async contract.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Feedback is perceivable without motion or color.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Feedback anchors to the control, not a region that may collapse.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Controls expose PRESSED and disabled-while-pending states.

principles_applied.name: Designed empty, loading, and error states
principles_applied.user_problem: Blank screens look broken; spinners hide structure.
principles_applied.application: Skeletons mirror final layout; empty states explain and offer the first action; errors offer retry.
principles_applied.tradeoff: Three extra designs per data surface.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Skeletons are aria-hidden with a live 'Loading' status.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Empty states keep the primary action visible at every width.

principles_applied.name: Semantic zoom
principles_applied.user_problem: Shrinking a desktop layout produces an unusable mobile one.
principles_applied.application: Responsive changes transform representation (table -> list, sidebar -> drawer), not just scale.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Reflow at 320 CSS px without two-dimensional scrolling (SC 1.4.10).
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Container queries where regions are reused.

principles_applied.name: Full keyboard operability
principles_applied.user_problem: Keyboard and switch users are locked out.
principles_applied.application: Every interaction has a keyboard path; focus is always visible and never obscured.
principles_applied.tradeoff: Custom widgets need roving tabindex work.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.1.1 Keyboard, 2.4.7 Focus Visible, 2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Sticky headers must not cover the focused element.

principles_applied.name: Truthful AI provenance
principles_applied.user_problem: Users over-trust or mis-attribute machine output.
principles_applied.application: AI output is wrapped in one trust envelope stating involvement, known provider/model, sources, and review status; no decorative confidence.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: Provenance is text, reachable by keyboard, announced when streaming completes.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: The provenance label never collapses away on narrow viewports.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: A single AITrustEnvelope scope per AI response.

principles_applied.name: Degraded-network resilience
principles_applied.user_problem: Live surfaces silently show stale data when the connection drops.
principles_applied.application: OFFLINE and STALE are explicit; reconnection is automatic with a visible manual retry.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: Connection status remains visible in collapsed layouts.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Stream/socket clients expose connection state and clean up on unmount.

principles_applied.name: Motion is optional
principles_applied.user_problem: Motion causes vestibular harm and distracts.
principles_applied.application: All non-essential motion is disabled under prefers-reduced-motion; meaning never depends on motion.
principles_applied.tradeoff: Some delight is lost for those users.
principles_applied.a11y_effect: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.3.3 Animation from Interactions (AAA) respected via reduced-motion.
principles_applied.responsive_effect: No motion-dependent reveal of content at any width.
principles_applied.implementation_effect: Motion reads semantic.motion tokens and a reduced-motion guard.

design_genome.hierarchy: strict typographic hierarchy; one focal element per view
design_genome.geometry: 4px-based radius, hairline borders, no shadows as decoration
design_genome.typography: system sans for UI, monospace for data; scale by role not by page
design_genome.color: neutral surfaces; accent reserved for the P0 action
design_genome.material: flat surfaces separated by borders and space
design_genome.signature: one product-specific element derived from Fixture Co's thesis (not generic decoration)

foundations: Tokens: DTCG 2025.10, 60 tokens in T1/T2/T3 tiers (prefix --ui-)
patterns: Core controls are native elements (button, a, input, select, dialog) before any custom widget.
Salience budget: P0 > P1 > P2 > P3; P3 regions are removed first under constraint.
content_rules: AI content is labeled AI-generated or AI-assisted; confidence is shown only from a calibrated backend value, otherwise 'Confidence not measured'.
state_rules: Async actions render LOADING then SUCCESS or ERROR; never a silent completion.
Determinate progress only from backend-reported values; never a synthetic percentage or ETA.
motion_rules: Feedback motion <= semantic.motion.duration.feedback; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce disables non-essential animation; state changes remain perceivable statically.
accessibility_rules: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum): Text meets 4.5:1 (AA); body text targets 7:1 (AAA) where tokens allow.
Forced colors (Windows High Contrast): Under forced-colors: active, states keep icon + text channels and borders use system colors.
WCAG 2.2 SC 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value: Every control exposes an accessible name, role, and state.
WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11 Non-text Contrast: Focus indicators, control borders and meaningful graphics reach 3:1.
WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.4 Resize Text: Text resizes to 200% without loss of content or function.
WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.1 Use of Color: Status and state are never conveyed by color alone.
WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.10 Reflow: Content reflows at 320 CSS px without two-dimensional scrolling (data tables excepted with scroll containers).
WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured (Minimum): Sticky/fixed regions never fully hide the focused element.
WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.6 Headings and Labels: Heading structure mirrors the visual hierarchy.
WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum): Interactive targets are at least 24x24 CSS px; primary touch targets 44x44.

provenance_rules: Label every AI output 'AI-generated' or 'AI-assisted' inside a single AITrustEnvelope scope.
Show provider/model only when the backend reports them; otherwise 'Not disclosed'.
Degraded or fallback output is labeled as such, never presented as model output.
attribution_rules: Show sources when the backend returns them; otherwise state 'Sources unavailable'.
uncertainty_rules: No numeric confidence unless a calibrated backend value exists; display 'Confidence not measured'.
feedback_rules: Offer feedback/retry only when a backend endpoint records it.

Regions in priority order: conversation [P0, stack, full_width when narrow]; composer [P0, stack, full_width when narrow]; sources [P2, stack, drawer when narrow]; history [P3, stack, priority_reduction when narrow].
